content.clinical_guidelines: The guidelines discuss various topics related to aortic dissection and arteritis, particularly focusing on giant cell arteritis and Takayasu arteritis. Pregnancy-related aortic complications, the use and management of glucocorticoids, immunosuppressives, and imaging techniques in arteritis are covered.
specific_topics: Aortic dissection risk management in pregnancy
Guidelines for diagnosis and management of giant cell arteritis
Use of imaging in diagnosing arteritis
Medication management, including glucocorticoids and immunotherapy for arteritis
